description: Pre-configured STAC catalog endpoints and default search parameters for Lab 03 (STAC catalog search). Reference these values in your prompts to geo-stac.

element84_earth_search.notes: Primary open catalog used throughout the workshop. Points to Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs on the public sentinel-cogs S3 bucket.

usgs_landsatlook.notes: USGS Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 surface reflectance.

default_area_of_interest.name: Denver, Colorado
default_area_of_interest.notes: Denver metro bounding box in EPSG:4326 (lon_min, lat_min, lon_max, lat_max). UTM Zone 13N is the correct projected CRS for area/distance work here.
